reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in a thread on their message in #central-team: "Thanks, Tobias. Noted for everyone here: expense reports are due this Friday, Oct 16."

I checked GBrain and found nothing about the expense deadline, but its search was running in keyword-only mode, so that isn't proof there's no note. I only echoed the reminder and didn't set up any follow-up reminder.
